timing: timeline.json (measured from the full take; every beat keys on a spoken word via wordAt)
world: one world: a phone, a day calendar, paper (kraft cards, tape, receipt, stamps) and time (clock, evening bar). Large objects whose parts move separately so the picture shows cause and effect.

type.rule: words move as whole units; typed text fills one whole word at a time

motionFamilies.draw-on: a stroke drawn along its path as the idea is spoken
motionFamilies.morph: a shape changing into its new meaning (a reply becomes a block of time; a line becomes a beam)
motionFamilies.reveal: a word uncovered after the expectation is built
motionFamilies.compare: at most two things at once
motionFamilies.hold: stillness for an idea that needs it

generatedOnScreen.note: strings drawn by components, not listed in copy.ts
items: calendar and evening hour labels «4 م» … «9 م» (digits 0–9 + م)
the contact avatar initial «ز» (first letter of «زميل»)

feedbackFromEpisode1: bigger main elements (phone 0.9 scale, calendar 600×760) instead of small icons in empty space
the paradox is on screen by second 10, the question by second 12
no row of three boxes: the steps change the phone and calendar themselves (sc06)
more kinetic type («لا» / «حاضر», «قرارك», the closing line) and collage (kraft card, tape, receipt, stamps)

scenes.name: الخطاف — «حاضر» التي أكلت المساء
scenes.purpose: within 12 s: the situation (a non-urgent message), the paradox (you wanted «لا», you sent «حاضر») and the question
scenes.visual: a large phone (right) with the message «ممكن تساعدني اليوم؟»; a large day calendar (left) with the evening booked for «مشروعي»
motion: build: the message pops in on «رسالة»
kinetic type in the field: «لا» «أستطيع» «اليوم» typed as whole words on the spoken words
erase word by word on «تمسحها»
«حاضر» typed and sent on «وترسل… حاضر»
morph: the sent «حاضر» flies into 6 pm and becomes the red «مساعدة» block that squeezes the project to a grey sliver
draw-on: a red ring around the sent reply on «غاضب»
reveal: the stage steps back and the question holds («فلماذا وافقت…» / «وأنت تريد أن تقول لا؟»)

scenes.name: الأثر، والوعد، والتوازن
scenes.purpose: what the reply cost (the evening, the project pushed to tomorrow and after), the promise (the two seconds between «لا» and «حاضر» open into a pause), then the nuance (helping is not the problem)
scenes.visual: the request with a «غير عاجل» stamp; a horizontal evening timeline (4 pm on the right) with a clock; the project card; big kinetic «لا» / «حاضر»; a stack of «حاضر» bubbles
motion: draw-on: the evening bar from «الطلب» to «المساء»
build: «حاضر» drops onto 6 pm; the help block grows on «ساعة» and «ساعتين»
morph: the project card is pushed off the bar to «غدًا», then «بعد غد»
compare: «لا» (blue) and «حاضر» (red) with a bracket «ثانيتان»; they part and a pause sign opens on «وقفة»
build: «حاضر» bubbles pile up on «توافق… مرة بعد مرة»

scenes.name: الكتاب والفكرة — الميزان والفاتورة
scenes.purpose: name the book and author (no cover image), then the idea: a «نعم» that keeps their approval moves our time to their side; what stays is resentment and worry; the receipt
scenes.visual: an original kraft-paper book card (title, author, role pill, tape); a balance «وقتي» / «رضاهم» with green time chips; a printed receipt
motion: build: title lines on «توقف» and «إرضاء»; red underline on «العادة»
compare: the card steps aside on «نعم» and the balance appears
morph: four time chips hop from «وقتي» to «رضاهم» on «لنحافظ / رضا / يكلفنا / أكثر»; the beam tilts
build: «استياء» and «قلق» drop into my pan
reveal: a receipt prints its rows on «طلب / ورد / وثمن», the last in red

scenes.name: سباق السؤالين
scenes.purpose: why «حاضر» came out: two questions race from the message; fear of the reaction takes the short lane and arrives first; the capacity question needs the calendar, which was never opened
scenes.visual: the message (top right); a short red lane and a long dotted blue lane through a closed calendar to the send button; the questions themselves are the runners
motion: draw-on: both lanes on «يتسابق»
build: «هل سينزعج؟» and «هل أقدر فعلًا؟» step onto their lanes on the spoken questions
the red question dashes on «سريع», pauses at a cracked heart on «خيبة… أمله», reaches «send» on «فيصل» → red «حاضر»
tape «لم يُفتح» across the closed calendar on «والجدول»
morph: the calendar grows and opens on «فيحتاج… تنظر»; the project glows on «وقتك»; a kraft note «وعدتُ نفسي: المشروع» on «وعدت»
kinetic type: «حاضر… قبل أن تصبح قرارك» word by word; the red question returns with the stamp «في رسالتنا»

scenes.name: التصحيح
scenes.purpose: the correction: not «لا» to everything, not suspicion of every request; a clear reply between an automatic «نعم» and an angry «لا»; respect both; clarity makes help a choice
scenes.visual: stamp «تصحيح مهم»; a field of «لا» stamps struck through; a request with «استغلال؟» struck; a spectrum line whose middle «ردّ واضح» becomes the pivot of a balance «وقتك» / «طلبه»; two calendars «اليوم» / «غدًا»
motion: build: «لا» stamps multiply on «لكل شيء»; one strike on «ولا»
draw-on: the spectrum line; «ردّ واضح» in the middle; both ends struck
morph: the line shortens and becomes the beam of the balance on «ردّ يحترم»
build: four «نعم» weights drop on «توافق دائمًا»; the beam tips; «وقتي أقل أهمية» on «وقتي»
compare: «اختيار» (green) vs «ردّ فعل» (struck)
morph: the help block lands in tomorrow on «غدًا» («مرتاح»); a dashed red ghost over today's project is struck on «منزعج»

scenes.name: إعادة المشهد — قرار يُبنى أمام المشاهد
scenes.purpose: the application, built as one decision on the same phone and calendar (no row of boxes): 1) pause, 2) review capacity (calendar before keyboard), 3) answer clearly and briefly; the optional alternative; «سأراجع…»; one clear sentence instead of a story
scenes.visual: sc01's end state rewinds; the same phone and calendar; a big clock that pins itself to the phone; the calendar opened; a kraft card «غدًا» with a half-hour slot; replies; a long paper that folds
motion: rewind on «فلنُعِد»: the sent «حاضر» un-sends, the evening unsqueezes, the calendar closes
step 1 on «توقّف»: the clock stops (aqua halo), the screen turns aqua, only the caret blinks; «غير عاجل» stamp; a ring draws for «دقيقة»; the clock pins itself to the phone

step 2 on «راجع قدرتك»: the calendar grows and opens on «افتح جدولك»; the keyboard drops away on «لوحة المفاتيح»; the project glows on «محجوز»; questions «هل أريد أن أساعد؟» → «ومتى أقدر؟» with the tomorrow card
step 3 on «أجب بوضوح»: the keyboard returns; «لا أستطيع اليوم.» typed word by word and sent → a check on the project; «أقدر غدًا نصف ساعة.» sent (dashed) → the tomorrow slot fills; «اختياري»
variants: a dashed «سأراجع وقتي وأرد عليك.»; «قصة طويلة وأعذار…» unrolls and folds away on «جملة»; the sent replies pulse on «واضحة»

scenes.name: بعد الرد
scenes.purpose: honest aftermath: some discomfort, maybe annoyance (possible, not certain); a simple answer; a clear reply does not guarantee everyone's approval but makes the decision yours; start with small requests; skill takes time and practice
scenes.visual: a red wobbling line («عدم ارتياح») and a typing bubble; «تمام، غدًا إذن»; kinetic type «قرارك» circled; request bubbles as growing steps; a practice bar
motion: draw-on: the red wave on «تشعر»
build: typing dots on «وقد ينزعج»; the answer replaces them on «تمام» and the wave settles
morph: the calm line slides down and becomes the practice track
kinetic type: «لا يضمن رضا الجميع» → «لكنه يجعل قرارك…» → «قرارك» with a green ring
build: four requests, each larger, on «بالطلبات / الصغيرة / حيث / يكلّف»; the bar fills to about two thirds on «فالمهارة… وتدريبًا»

scenes.name: الإغلاق — الرسالة نفسها، والفرق ثانيتان
scenes.purpose: close the loop with the hook: same message, read, a pause, then a clear reply; the evening stays with the project; the difference is two seconds; the closing line; the three steps as one path for the next request
scenes.visual: the sc01 phone and calendar; green replies; a bracket «ثانيتان» between the message and the reply; the stage steps back for the closing line; one drawn path with three stops
motion: build: the message on «وصلت», read ticks on «وقرأتها»
hold: aqua screen and the pinned clock on «وتوقّفت لحظة»
build: the two-line reply on «ثم أجبت»
glow and check on the project on «المساء لمشروعك»
draw-on: the bracket «ثانيتان» on «ثانيتان»
reveal: «قبل أن تقول «نعم»…» / «تأكّد أنها إجابتك»
draw-on: one path «توقّف» → «راجع وقتك» → «أجب» on the spoken steps
end card «فكرة من كتاب» / «كتاب وبس» 3 s before the end
